name: Zutto Issho
source:
Main character returns to the home town. Forgotten feelings revive as he meets old friends. Who will he want to stay forever through his life?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公回到故乡，与老朋友们重逢，早已遗忘的感情也随之复苏。他希望与谁相伴一生，永远在一起？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
